$comment: Trusted receiver policy, read from the PR base ref only (git show <base_sha>:<path>), never from the PR's own tree. Each entry declares a behavioral check this receiver independently re-derives from the candidate's actual bytes -- never the untrusted evidence package's own self-reported checks/run_check.py result. Candidate code is executed only inside a disposable, network-isolated container pinned by image digest (see executionImage); it never sees expectedOutput and never decides pass/fail -- the receiver's own job compares the container's raw observed output against expectedOutput out-of-band (see run_execution_bundle/verify_execution_results in receiver/check.py). candidateScratchRelative mirrors an explicit throwaway scratch-directory layout, not a path guessed from the real repo.
